why_addendum_exists: Parallel re-entry found the E5 candidate already handed off. This file contributes only non-duplicate false-positive and staleness evidence and tightens Trigger4 acceptance semantics.

new_evidence.unrelated_write_control: Local E3: a foreign commit to an unrelated table advanced observer data_version while the protected row remained unchanged.
new_evidence.schema_classifier: Foreign DDL advanced schema_version, but data_version already signaled the external commit; schema_version is a classifier/revalidation aid, not a durable revision authority.
new_evidence.f2_prior_counterevidence: PR655/run 33295636700 already proved same-inode schema/full-fingerprint drift can remain accepted by the open store-use guard.
new_evidence.staleness_check: Current _assert_current_file_identity remains path/device/inode-only at the relevant boundary, so PR655 is not superseded by later G3/G4 recovery work.

required_trigger4_semantics: Treat PRAGMA main.data_version only as a connection-local invalidation hint.
Do not persist raw data_version or compare it across reopened connections.
Do not turn any data_version change into global UnifiedDB corruption/failure.
On mismatch, establish the intended transaction/snapshot and re-read/revalidate only the protected WP206 evidence needed by the operation.
Unrelated external write + unchanged protected row must be allowed after successful targeted revalidation.
Protected-row or schema mutation must not authorize continuation from a stale previously observed context.
Same-Connection arbitrary writes remain explicitly outside coverage and need a separate writer-ownership/provenance falsifier if relevant.

mandatory_ablation_before_product_source.case_a: foreign unrelated-table write on same inode; verify whether baseline already safely re-reads the protected row; candidate must not introduce false rejection
mandatory_ablation_before_product_source.case_b: foreign protected-row or relevant schema mutation on same inode; verify whether baseline can perform an authority-sensitive continuation without fresh protected evidence
mandatory_ablation_before_product_source.decision_rule: If exact-current baseline already closes both correctness cases through fresh transaction/row/digest/provenance checks, retire EXTERNAL_SQLITE_REVISION_FENCE as redundant diagnostics. If case_b remains open while case_a remains valid, implement the smallest ephemeral revision-hint plus targeted-revalidation fence.

measure: extra SQLite reads/transactions only after mismatch
